newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Thai Bangchak plans to shut 40,000-bpd CDU Aug'97.
newsitem.headline: Thai Bangchak plans to shut 40,000-bpd CDU Aug'97.

text.p: Refiner Bangchak Petroleum Plc plans to shut a 40,000 barrel-per-day (bpd) crude distillation unit (CDU) in August next year for maintenance, a company source said on Tuesday.
The source said the planned shutdown of its CDU No.2 for 20 to 30 days was still subject to confirmation sometime in the first quarter next year.
He said there were no plans to shut down the other 80,000 bpd CDU No. 3. The refinery which is located in Bangkok has a total capacity of 120,000 bpd.
